entities.name: Raissa
entities.description: A satyr on Theros and the mother of Xenagos, who sees visions of her son's future in a starfish's pool.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: Raissa's wild, horned son, destined to visit other planes and challenge the constellations.

entities.name: Sigiled Starfish
entities.description: A magical tidal-pool creature whose dancing sigils give Raissa visions.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: City where satyr women seek help with births; Raissa and Xenagos are cast out of it.

entities.name: Setessan Order of Midwives
entities.description: The midwives of Setessa, one of whom delivers Xenagos.

entities.name: Skola Valley
entities.description: The satyr home and site of carefree revels.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: A god whose temple has a ruling council in Setessa.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The night sky full of constellations that Raissa sees in her vision.

entities.name: Constellations
entities.description: The living constellations in Nyx who turn on Xenagos in Raissa's vision.

events.summary: Raissa, pregnant with twins, consults the Sigiled Starfish and sees visions of the womb.
events.quote: Raissa had visited the briny tidal pool often as she carried the twins.

events.summary: In her vision the boy crowds out and eclipses the girl; Raissa breaches the vision and afterward feels only one child within her.
events.quote: feeling only the presence of one child within her.

events.summary: At eight months the starfish shows Raissa places beyond Theros that her child will visit.
events.quote: Other planes of existence her child would visit.

events.summary: Xenagos is born, kicking and horned; the midwife curses him and leaves in a huff.
events.quote: when the midwife finally pulled him from her, he kicked at her.

events.summary: Raissa decides not to abandon her son as most satyr women do, believing he is special and needs her.
events.quote: But Raissa looked down at the pink face of her boy and knew she could not.

events.summary: Six years later Xenagos shoves a council member's son to his death from a rope bridge, so they are cast out of Setessa.
events.quote: He had caused them to be cast out of Setessa

events.summary: Xenagos sets his mother's bed alight and hits her on the head with a stick, giggling.
events.quote: he struck her in the side of her head with his stick.

events.summary: Raissa revisits the starfish and sees the constellations of Nyx turn on her son in outrage and advance with storms.
events.quote: They faced Raissa's son, and outrage flared in their eyes.

events.summary: The vision ends with Xenagos laughing and holding a stick dripping ichor, the starfish impaled on it.
events.quote: At the end of the stick writhed the impaled gray body of the starfish.

relations.quote: She is the mother of Xenagos .

relations.note: In the vision they advance on him in outrage.
relations.quote: They faced Raissa's son, and outrage flared in their eyes.
